# RepMaths

## About
RepMaths is a premium, lightning-fast suite of fitness calculators, strength training generators, and nutrition planners. Designed for powerlifters, bodybuilders, athletes, and fitness enthusiasts, it provides evidence-based tools for optimizing workout programming, auto-regulation, body composition, and macronutrient tracking.

## Key Tools & Calculators
- **Strength & Powerlifting:** One Rep Max (1RM) Calculator (including specific Bench Press Max Calculator and Military Press 1RM Estimator), Overhead Press 1RM (Brzycki/Epley), Training Max (TM) Calculator, Wendler 5/3/1 Program Planner, Warm-up Set Generator (CNS Priming), RPE to RIR Calculator.
- **Gym Math & Equipment:** Barbell Plate Loading Calculator (easily determine how much is a 45 on each side, or how many plates is 135, 225, or 315), Weight Plate Calculator.
- **Nutrition & Body Composition:** TDEE Calculator (Mifflin-St Jeor), BMR Calculator (Mifflin St Jeor Formula Calculator), Macro Split Calculator (Cutting/Bulking/Maintenance), Protein Intake Calculator (Hypertrophy/Fat Loss), Daily Water Intake Calculator (Calculate daily water intake or how much water should I drink), Body Fat Percentage Calculator (US Navy Method).

## Content & Methodology
- Strictly utilizes scientifically validated algorithms and models (e.g., Mifflin-St Jeor, US DoD Navy Tape Method, Reactive Training Systems RPE scale).
- Core focus areas: CNS fatigue management, determining one rep max safely, submaximal training, muscle hypertrophy, absolute strength programming, and sustainable body recomposition.
- Application design: Ad-free, instant client-side calculation, mobile-first responsive architecture.

## Usage & Disclaimer
All content, tools, and generated calculations are provided for informational and educational purposes only. They do not constitute medical advice. Users should consult a qualified healthcare or certified fitness professional before beginning any new rigorous training block or severe caloric diet regimen.
